title: Week of June 15 — Iran Deal Rally + FOMC Wednesday

macro.iran: MoU signed over weekend. Trump confirmed deal complete. Strait of Hormuz to reopen. Peace signing ceremony Friday June 19 Geneva. WTI -5% on day. Energy (XLE) -3.48% = cash rotating from defensive/energy to tech.
macro.bonds: 10Y yield 4.47% (-0.22%). Rate cut odds unchanged. FOMC hold Wednesday widely expected.
macro.oil: WTI $81.43 (-5%). XLE worst sector today. Oil weakness = tailwind for margin-sensitive tech names.
macro.fed: FOMC rate decision Wednesday June 18 2:00 PM ET. Kevin Warsh first press conference. 4th consecutive hold expected. RULE: NO overnight holds Monday or Tuesday. Close ALL positions by 2:00 PM ET Tuesday June 17. Flat into FOMC.
macro.catalyst: Iran deal MoU = primary catalyst. MAG7 +1.16% (TSLA) to +4.67% (META). XLK +3.78%. VIX -8.37% to 16.20. Juneteenth Friday June 20 = market closed = 4-day trading week (Tue-Thu tradeable).
